intro: Mentoring is the part of senior engineering that does not show up in a timing report. I have done it deliberately, with a plan and material, not as an afterthought.

items.title: Mentored 2 interns through a full design cycle
items.detail: Set their technical direction, reviewed their work, and got both to a point where their blocks could go through review without rescue.

items.title: Internship mentor lead
items.detail: Coordinated the internship programme: prepared the internship and training plans and kept the mentoring consistent across the group.

items.title: Built and delivered the training material
items.detail: Taught floorplanning, preCTS, routing and the basic physical design flow to fresh engineers, using the same blocks and checks the production flow uses.
